_comment: The source registry for NYC. One entry per source, each naming an adapter.
MVP = tier 2 only (NYC Open Data). Tier 0 aggregators (PredictHQ, SeatGeek)
and tier 1 venue adapters need keys or bespoke parsers; see coverage.md.
Datasets audited 2026-08-01. fudw-fgrp (Parks Events Listing) and
6v4b-5gp4 (Parks Special Events) are DEAD -- their newest rows are from
2019 -- and are deliberately absent rather than silently returning nothing.
